property_summary: For any caller and deposit amount, if the callee's receive() reverts then C.withdrawAll() reverts (so call does not complete) — the mutant that removes require(callResult) allows withdrawAll to succeed despite a reverting recipient, violating this property.
change_summary: Delete the require(callResult) so that failures of the external call do not revert withdrawAll (allowing it to complete even if the send failed).
